name: Floral Printed Kaftan Top in White
description:
Embrace an effortless blend of traditional charm and modern bohemian flair with the Floral Printed Kaftan Top in White by Gorur Ghash. Featuring a vibrant, retro-inspired botanical print dominated by warm marigold and peach sunflowers, this longline tunic instantly brightens up your wardrobe.

 

The elegant V-neckline and wide sleeves are beautifully adorned with delicate white lace trim, making it a standout statement piece for festive gatherings or elevated daily wear. Crafted from a premium, lightweight mixed polyester fabric, this loose-fit kaftan top delivers exceptional everyday comfort with a breezy, fluid drape that keeps you cool all day. The relaxed, straight silhouette is enhanced by side slits for easy movement, ensuring a perfect mix of style and practicality. Pair it with white sidekick pants or formal pants for a sophisticated, contemporary ethnic-fusion look.

 

Features:

  • Fit: Relaxed & Straight Drop
  • Silhouette: Longline &  Wide Sleeves
  • Details: V-Neckline, Lace Trimming, Side Slits
  • Color: White
  • Fabric: Polyester
  • GSM: 80+
  • Wash Instruction: Follow the care label.
  • A Gorur Ghash Original
  • Made in Bangladesh

name: Printed Ethnic Top in Green
description:
Printed Ethnic Top in Green by Ghash — a perfect blend of heritage prints and modern statement style. This elegant top combines intricate ethnic motifs with a rich green & pink palette, creating a look that feels both timeless and contemporary.

 

Designed for comfort and statement appeal, the detailed floral prints and subtle border accents on sleeves celebrate heritage while staying fashion-forward. The relaxed silhouette, wide sleeves & boat collar add a touch of grace, making it perfect for festive gatherings, casual outings, or simply elevating everyday style. Pair it with sidekick pants, formalwear, or denim for a modern ethnic look that transitions seamlessly from day to evening.
